system: CrO  quintet (5-Pi) vs triplet, R=1.621 A, CAS(10,10)=20q
gap_definition: E(triplet) - E(quintet) [eV]; gap>0 => quintet ground (agrees with experiment X 5-Pi)
key_finding: DFT functionals span 1.91 eV and B3LYP flips the ground state to triplet; CASCI/QSCI give one consistent quintet ground state, agreeing with the experimental X 5-Pi term. A B3LYP-only screen would carry the wrong spin ground state.
honest_caveats: CAS(10,10)/def2-SVP is a fixed modest active space; the CASCI/QSCI gap is the single value DFT scatters around, not a benchmark-quality experimental gap.
Each spin state uses CASCI on its own ROHF orbitals (standard), not state-averaged CASSCF.
The robust, defensible claim is the SIGN/ordering agreement with experiment and the 1.9 eV DFT spread, not the precise gap magnitude.
